description: This file defines a class 'BarCodeRenderInfo' that holds temporary rendering information for barcode rendering within a PDF processing library. It encapsulates properties like graphics context, styling brushes, font, position, and rendering metrics.

classes.name: BarCodeRenderInfo
classes.description: A class that stores temporary information required during the rendering of barcodes on PDF documents, including graphics context, styles, font, position, and sizing information.

methods.name: BarCodeRenderInfo
methods.description: Constructor initializing the rendering context with graphics, brush, optional font, and position.
